title: OMS Closure Statement v0.1 (Draft)
description: JSON Schema for an in-toto Statement v1 carrying the OMS closure predicate (spec/closure/v0.1.md). The subject binds the statement to an OMS-signed model by its manifest digest.

_type.description: in-toto Statement type URI (fixed by the in-toto spec).

subject.description: Exactly one entry: the model the closure belongs to.

digest.description: Exactly one key, omsManifest. Any other key, including the OMS root digest under sha256, is not allowed (spec/closure/v0.1.md Section 3.2).

omsManifest.description: Manifest digest of the model (spec/closure/v0.1.md Section 4), lowercase hex.
